args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api has been failing health checks since deploying v2.3.1 to production (unhealthy in all regions, error rate 0.18). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an error rate of 0.18. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the latest production release and unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release (v2.2.9 was older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback succeeded (`status: rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures after the v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate down to 0.002.

Note: I did not deploy v2.3.1 again or any other new version — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
